SELECT 
  'Jonathan Kitterhing (208415155065)' as delegate,
  COUNT(*) as meeting_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(m.timeSlot ORDER BY m.timeSlot) as slots
FROM meetings m WHERE m.attendeeId = '208415155065' AND m.isVisible = 1
UNION ALL
